text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'A step counts as detected when the estimate rises by at least half the step within 3 weeks of it. Share of semi-synthetic steps detected, on the scoring units. Dashed line: 80%, the share the plan's detection limit asks for. Steps of 5%, 10%, 20%, and 30% of the Primary's mean capacity. Each point in the lower panels rests on few units.'
text.tspan: A step counts as detected when the estimate rises by at least half the step within 3 weeks
of it. Share of semi-synthetic steps detected, on the scoring units. Dashed line: 80%, the
share the plan's detection limit asks for. Steps of 5%, 10%, 20%, and 30% of the Primary's
mean capacity. Each point in the lower panels rests on few units.
